body: NFRD ANCHOR BLOCKER, RE-DERIVED FROM GIT: the final assigned path is not in main. git ls-files has no consumer/NfrdIntakePublicSuite.scala; the shared untracked blob is 357b5026faa06cdd0a9bffa94bb19e7482f02569, exactly the file from old cand-4SEC14PYRWZQAYRP9X587Q8ZCG / 16c85d4, whose current ledger is pending and review_blocking. The later NFRD candidates 7c7858f3 (cand-2KZH...) and 99602baa (cand-67RY...) are also pending, and direct git merge-base checks show none of 16c85d4, 7c7858f3, or 99602baa is an ancestor of main. Therefore there is no tracked main path on which I can make the assigned test-only candidate; editing the shared file would modify a stale artifact from another unresolved candidate, and basing on any NFRD attempt would choose its lineage without authority. Additional design constraint for the eventual slice: NfrdBaseballSpec, VerifiedParticipant, NfrdBaseballReceipt, and NfrdBaseballCourt are private[bench], so an ordinary classOf/value anchor in the external storymodel4s.consumer package is not source-legal; a test-only same-compilation-unit internal-package anchor may be possible once the governing NFRD candidate is selected. REQUESTED DECISION: either land/select the governing NFRD candidate and reassign the now-tracked suite, or explicitly authorize a named candidate base. Until then I am stopping on this path, with no reservation or shared edit.
